column4: single-dialect test (cleat#4285): it runs scripts/find-histories-with-a-call-after-a-pending-await.sql, a PostgreSQL-only operator query, over rows written through the store, so it needs a PostgreSQL and skips on a job that has none. The MySQL and SQL Server arms of this job configure their own dialect only; no MySQL or SQL Server query exists (the upgrade note says so).
